verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents strict typing, typed tool or agent schemas, or build-time schema validation that would let a coding agent catch its own mistakes. Several items are related but do not deliver this story: support for typed languages (TypeScript, Go, Java, Kotlin), an OpenAPI spec for the dev server, "single-turn controlled output" in the Task API, and runtime evals. These are adjacent features or host-language properties, not an ADK-provided build-time validation capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on strict typing and schema validation so a coding agent catches its own mistakes at build time
